desc: corner: dev=eth0 arx=off atx=on rxu=absent rxf=absent txu=absent txf=absent irq=rx-usecs-irq rate=pkt-rate-low lowhigh=tx-usecs-high cqe=rxoff aggr=bytes rxcqe=absent
